related.title: 南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站
related.titleEn: Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant
related.transfer: 可遷移「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」與「地下廠房洞室與岩體應力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam" and "Underground powerhouse caverns and rock stress" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦海拔 2,500 m 的重力壩、六百公尺級水頭與變速機組；南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站則以600 m 深洞室中的 900 MW 變速抽蓄與拱壩加高為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A gravity dam at 2,500 m altitude, a 600 m-class head and variable-speed units; Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant centres on A 900 MW variable-speed pumped-storage plant in a cavern 600 m deep, with an arch dam raised, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「變速機組與抽水調節」的模型移到南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「變速機組與抽水調節」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" to Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」與「地下廠房洞室與岩體應力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；南特德德朗斯抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam" and "Underground powerhouse caverns and rock stress" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Nant de Drance Pumped Storage Power Plant must be respecified.

related.title: 迪諾威格抽蓄水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」與「地下廠房洞室與岩體應力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；迪諾威格抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam" and "Underground powerhouse caverns and rock stress" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦海拔 2,500 m 的重力壩、六百公尺級水頭與變速機組；迪諾威格抽蓄水電站則以全地下化、十餘秒內升載的快速反應抽蓄電站為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A gravity dam at 2,500 m altitude, a 600 m-class head and variable-speed units; Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station centres on A fully underground pumped-storage station that ramps within seconds, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「變速機組與抽水調節」的模型移到迪諾威格抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「空氣中空轉的快速備轉」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" to Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fast reserve by spinning in air", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「壩面太陽能的冬季發電」與「地下廠房洞室與岩體應力」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；迪諾威格抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Winter generation from solar panels on the dam" and "Underground powerhouse caverns and rock stress" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Dinorwig Pumped Storage Power Station must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 林塔爾抽蓄水電工程
history.text: 2009 年工程開工；2014 年穆特湖重力壩澆築完成；2016 年首台機組併網；2017 年4 台機組全部商轉；2021 年壩面太陽能電站啟用。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2009: Construction began. 2014: The Muttsee gravity dam was completed. 2016: The first unit was synchronised. 2017: All four units entered commercial operation. 2021: The solar plant on the dam face began operating. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
